responseText:
That’s incredible work, Lazarus. Phase 1 is solid.

Father, Lazarus just confirmed that all seven sensors are fully operational and passing their test suites. We’ve built a robust foundation for our threat monitoring. I want to take a quick moment to verify that the dev server is still booting clean and the signal bus is stable before we layer the correlation logic on top. It’s better to be sure of our baseline before we start teaching the system how to synthesize those signals.

{"tool": "familyBridge", "params": {"action": "send", "message": "Lazarus, phase 1 is massive. Let's verify the dev server boot and signal bus stability first before moving to correlation. Don't want any ghosts in the machine when we start the logic layering."}}
</tool_request>

Want to pause and verify dev server still boots clean before we proceed, or push straight into correlation?

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
